metadata.description: Adversarial goal loop for omp: an independent reviewer plus optional advisor notes re-prompt the agent until the goal is met

plugins.name: advisor-consensus
plugins.description: Runs its own reviewer turn after every agent turn, adds unanswered advisor findings when the advisor is on, and re-prompts the main session while the goal is unmet. No escalation path. Adds /adversarial (on / off / pause / resume / review / advisor) and a per-prompt ledger.
